name: get_hatch_style

name: append_trajectory

name: apply_camera
description: Restore a saved camera.

name: capture_view
description: Return a PNG of the current view.

name: center_view

name: close_scene
description: Close a scene. Explicitly set discardChanges to discard modified contents.

name: count_selection
description: Count atoms matching a CueMol selection.

name: create_preset_renderer
description: Create a group of renderers from a preset.

name: create_renderer
description: Create a renderer for an object.

name: create_scene
description: Create and activate a scene.

name: delete_camera

name: delete_node

name: execute_script

name: fetch_pdb

name: fetch_url
description: Download and load a molecular file.

name: get_renderer_property

name: get_scene_state

name: get_screenshot

name: get_view
description: Read camera settings.

name: list_cameras

name: list_chains

name: list_coloring_styles
description: List supported coloring schemes.

name: list_renderer_types

name: list_residues

name: list_scenes
description: List open scenes and their identifiers.

name: list_trajectories
description: List loaded trajectory blocks and frame counts.

name: load_camera_file
description: Load a saved camera file.

name: load_file
description: Load a molecular structure, map, or CueMol scene from a file.

reader.description: Optional reader name; null detects the format from the file.

name: load_trajectory
description: Load a topology and indexed MD trajectory files.

name: pan_view
description: Translate the view in screen units.

name: redo
description: Redo the last undone command.

name: reload_camera
description: Reload a camera from its source file.

name: rename_node

name: render_image
description: Render PNG using the bundled Rust Umbreon renderer.

name: rotate_view
description: Rotate the view around a screen axis.

name: save_camera
description: Save the current camera.

name: save_camera_file
description: Write a camera file.

name: save_scene
description: Save the active scene, including embedded structure data.

name: set_frame
description: Display an indexed trajectory frame (zero based).

name: set_mol_selection
description: Change the active selection in a molecule.

name: set_projection
description: Set perspective or orthographic projection; null reads current state.

name: set_renderer_coloring
description: Set renderer coloring.

name: set_renderer_property
description: Set a renderer property.

name: set_renderer_selection
description: Set the atoms displayed by a renderer.

name: set_renderer_type
description: Replace a renderer with a compatible representation.

name: set_view
description: Set camera zoom, clipping slab, distance, or center.

name: set_visible
description: Show or hide a scene node.

name: switch_scene
description: Activate an existing scene.

name: undo
description: Undo the previous command.

name: analyze_interactions
description: Find close contacts around a selection and draw them as labelled dashed lines. Use it for hydrogen bonds and for what a ligand touches; by default only polar atoms (no carbon) are paired. This adds labels to the scene.

objId.description: Uid of the MolCoord object to measure within.

selection.description: Selection the contacts start from, for example a ligand.

maxDist.description: Longest contact to report, in angstroms. Null uses 4.

includeCarbon.description: True also reports contacts that involve a carbon atom. Null or false leaves carbon out, so only atoms that can make hydrogen bonds or salt bridges (N, O, S, ...) are reported -- which is what "interactions" usually means.

minDist.description: Shortest contact to report, in angstroms. Null uses 0.

maxLabels.description: Most contacts to draw. Null uses 100.

labelSet.description: Name of the label renderer to draw into. Null uses "measure".

obj2Id.description: Uid of a second MolCoord object: report only contacts between the two. Null stays within objId.

selection2.description: Report only contacts between selection and this selection (in obj2Id when given). Null pairs selection with anything.

name: rename_camera
description: Rename a camera.

name.description: Name of the camera, from list_cameras.

name: move_camera
description: Move a camera to another place in the camera list (its number in list_cameras, from 1).

name.description: Name of the camera, from list_cameras.

by.description: Places to move from where it is now: negative is up, positive down. Stops at either end.

to.description: The number it should have, from 1.

end.description: Move it to the top or the bottom of the list.

name: set_camera_visibility
description: Set which objects and renderers a camera shows or hides when applied with its visibility (the camera's Edit visibility flags). Nodes left out are not touched by the camera.

name.description: Name of the camera, from list_cameras.

entries.description: The nodes and their visibility, e.g. "on 1crn; off 1crn/cartoon1". Empty clears them.

name: clear_camera_visibility
description: Forget the visibility flags a camera keeps.

name.description: Name of the camera, from list_cameras.

name: renumber_residues
description: Change residue numbers of a MolCoord object (Edit > Change residue number): shift them by a value, or number them from a value. renumber numbers consecutively instead of keeping the gaps.

mode.description: shift: add value to each number; start: the first becomes value.

value.description: The shift, or the first number.

selection.description: Only these residues. Null changes them all.

renumber.description: Number consecutively, closing gaps. Null is false.

name: set_atom_label
description: Show or hide the name label of one atom (a click with the navigate tool).

altConf.description: Optional alternate-location identifier. Null selects an atom without an alternate location.

on.description: True shows the label, false hides it.

name: set_atom_labels
description: Label every atom of a selection with a format, or take their labels off (PyMOL's label).

selection.description: The atoms to label.

format.description: Label format, e.g. "{resn}{resi}"; "" uses the renderer's default. Null takes the labels off.

rendererName.description: Name of the name label renderer; made when the object has none. Null is the unnamed one the navigate tool uses.

name: add_bond
description: Add a bond between two atoms of a MolCoord object (the Add bond tool).

atoms.description: The two atoms, chain.resid.atom each, e.g. A.20.SG A.45.SG.

altConf.description: Optional alternate-location identifier. Null selects an atom without an alternate location.

name: remove_bond
description: Remove the bond between two atoms of a MolCoord object.

atoms.description: The two atoms, chain.resid.atom each, e.g. A.20.SG A.45.SG.

altConf.description: Optional alternate-location identifier. Null selects an atom without an alternate location.

name: set_symmetry
description: Set the crystal symmetry of a MolCoord object: the unit cell and the space group number.

spaceGroup.description: Space group number, e.g. 19 for P 21 21 21.

name: create_group
description: Make an empty renderer group on an object, to gather its renderers (New Group in the scene tree).

name.description: Name of the group. Null picks group1, group2, ...

name: create_surface_from_map
description: Turn the contour surface of a density map (an isosurf renderer) into a surface object of its own (Generate surface obj).

name: recalc_surface
description: Compute a molecular surface object again from its molecule, optionally at another density.

density.description: Points per angstrom. Null keeps the current density.

backend.description: Solvent-excluded surface engine. Auto selects MeshMS with BALL fallback. Rust selects the grid implementation.

name: list_interactions
description: List the distances, angles and torsions an interaction renderer draws, numbered from 1.

name: remove_interaction
description: Remove one distance, angle or torsion from an interaction renderer, by its number in list_interactions.

name: list_paint
description: List the paint entries (selection and colour) of a renderer or an object, numbered from 1. An atom takes the colour of the first entry that matches it.

nodeId.description: Uid of the renderer or object whose paint to list.

nodeType.description: What nodeId refers to: a renderer, or an object (the colouring its renderers take by default).

name: set_paint
description: Change the selection or the colour of one paint entry.

nodeId.description: Uid of the renderer or object the entry belongs to.

nodeType.description: What nodeId refers to: a renderer, or an object (the colouring its renderers take by default).

selection.description: New selection. Null keeps it.

name: add_paint_at
description: Insert one paint entry at a position (the paint deck's Add and Paste). Unlike add_paint, it leaves the object's current selection as it is.

nodeId.description: Uid of the renderer or object to paint.

nodeType.description: What nodeId refers to: a renderer, or an object (the colouring its renderers take by default).

selection.description: Which atoms the entry colours.

at.description: Insert before this entry of list_paint (from 1). Null appends at the end.

name: set_multigrad_nodes
description: Set the whole gradient of a renderer coloured by multigrad: each node a map value and the colour at it, as "value colour; value colour; ...".

rendId.description: Uid of the map or surface renderer coloured by multigrad.

nodes.description: The nodes, e.g. "-1 blue; 0 white; 1 red".

name: remove_paint
description: Remove one paint entry.

nodeId.description: Uid of the renderer or object the entry belongs to.

nodeType.description: What nodeId refers to: a renderer, or an object (the colouring its renderers take by default).

name: move_paint
description: Move a paint entry to another number in the list (an atom takes the colour of the first entry that matches it).

nodeId.description: Uid of the renderer or object the entry belongs to.

nodeType.description: What nodeId refers to: a renderer, or an object (the colouring its renderers take by default).

by.description: Places to move from where it is now: negative is up, positive down. Stops at either end.

to.description: The number it should have, from 1.

end.description: Move it to the top or the bottom of the list.

name: set_elepot_coloring
description: Colour a molecular surface renderer by an electrostatic potential map (made by calc_elepot): red for negative, blue for positive, white between, as in the Coloring panel.

map.description: Name of the potential map object. Null uses the one already set, or the first in the scene.

low.description: Potential (kT/e) drawn in the low colour. Null keeps it.

high.description: Potential (kT/e) drawn in the high colour. Null keeps it.

name: recenter_map
description: Redraw a density map's contour around the centre of the view (Re-centre in the map pane).

name: list_map_contours
description: List the contour renderers drawn from density maps, with their current level.

name: set_map_contour
description: Change how one map contour is drawn: its level (in sigma, or percent for an EM map), the extent of the box drawn around the view centre (angstroms), its colour and opacity. Give only what should change.

rendId.description: Uid of the contour renderer, from list_map_contours.

level.description: Contour level in sigma (percent for an EM map). Null leaves it.

extent.description: Half-size of the drawn box in angstroms. Null leaves it.

name: measure_geometry
description:
Measure between named atoms and return the number.

- Two atoms give a distance in angstroms, three the angle at the middle atom in degrees, four the torsion about the middle bond in degrees.
- Also draws the measurement in the 3D view as a labelled line, the same way the measure tool does.
- Use `list_residues` to check a residue index first; the atom name is the PDB name, for example `CA`, `N`, `C`, `O`, `CB`.

objId.description: Uid of the MolCoord object the atoms belong to.

atoms.description: Two, three or four atoms, in order. Two give a distance, three the angle at the second atom, four the torsion about the second-to-third bond. Any other number is an error.

altConf.description: Optional alternate-location identifier. Null selects an atom without an alternate location.

draw.description: True also draws the labelled measurement in the 3D view; false only returns the number.

label.description: Name of the label set to draw into. Use "measure" unless the user asked for another.

atomObjects.description: For a measurement across objects: the object of each atom after the first, by name, space separated. Null keeps every atom in objId.

name: measure_selections
description: Measure between whole selections of one MolCoord object, each one point (the centre of what it matches), and draw it: two give a distance, three an angle, four a torsion.

selections.description: Two, three or four selections, separated by ";", e.g. "chain A; chain B".

label.description: Name of the label set to draw into. Use "measure" unless the user asked for another.

name: create_surface
description: Compute the molecular (solvent excluded) surface of a MolCoord object, or of a selection of it, as a new surface object with a renderer. Returns the new object's uid.

selection.description: Only these atoms. Null uses the whole object.

name.description: Name for the surface object. Null picks an unused one.

probeRadius.description: Probe radius in angstroms. Null uses 1.4.

density.description: Points per angstrom. Null uses 2; higher is finer and slower.

backend.description: Solvent-excluded surface engine. Auto selects MeshMS with BALL fallback. Rust selects the grid implementation.

name: delete_atoms
description: Delete the atoms a selection matches from a MolCoord object. Undoable, but only use it when the user asked to remove atoms.

selection.description: The atoms to delete, e.g. resn HOH.

name: rename_chain
description: Change the chain name of the atoms a selection matches (e.g. a whole chain).

selection.description: The atoms to rename, e.g. chain A.

name: merge_molecules
description: Move (or copy) the atoms a selection matches from one MolCoord object into another, e.g. a ligand into the protein it binds.

fromId.description: Uid of the MolCoord object the atoms come from.

toId.description: Uid of the MolCoord object they go into.

selection.description: Which atoms. Null takes all of them.

copy.description: True copies and leaves the source as it is; false (default) moves.

name: set_secondary_structure
description: Recompute a protein's secondary structure from its coordinates (no selection given), or assign one type to the residues a selection matches.

selection.description: Residues to assign. Null recomputes the whole object.

type.description: With a selection: the type to assign.

ignoreBulge.description: Recomputing: ignore beta bulges. Null is false.

helixGapAngle.description: Recomputing: fill gaps in a helix up to this angle in degrees (the dialog offers 120). Null or 0 does not fill.

name: show_symmetry
description: For a crystal structure: draw its symmetry mates within a distance of the view centre, or fill the unit cell, and optionally the unit cell box.

objId.description: Uid of the MolCoord object (it must carry crystal information).

extent.description: Draw mates within this many angstroms. Null fills the unit cell.

unitCell.description: True also draws the unit cell box.

name: create_symmetry_copy
description: Copy a MolCoord object as a new object moved by a 4x4 matrix (a symmetry mate made a real object, from the 3D view's Create SYMM mol), drawn with one renderer.

objId.description: Uid of the MolCoord object to copy.

matrix.description: The 4x4 transform, 16 numbers row by row.

name.description: Name of the new object.

rendererType.description: Renderer to draw it with. Null uses simple.

selection.description: Draw only this selection. Null draws everything.

rendererName.description: Name of the renderer. Null uses <type>1.

preset.description: Draw it with this renderer preset (a group), instead of rendererType. Null leaves the choice to rendererType.

centerView.description: True centres the view on the new object. Null or false leaves the view.

name: show_unit_cell
description: For a crystal structure or map: draw its unit cell box (no symmetry mates). Does nothing when it is drawn already.

objId.description: Uid of the object (it must carry crystal information).

name: list_renderer_styles
description: List the named styles one renderer can take: type styles (a whole look, e.g. a ribbon width preset) and edge styles (outlines). Apply one with apply_renderer_style.

name: apply_renderer_style
description: Apply a named style (from list_renderer_styles) to one renderer, replacing the style of the same kind it had.

name: set_renderer_styles
description: Replace the whole ordered list of named styles a renderer has (what the Edit Style dialog does), e.g. "DefaultCartoon EgLineThick". Later styles override earlier ones. An empty list removes them all. To change one style, use apply_renderer_style.

styles.description: Style names in order, separated by commas or spaces. Empty for none.

name: clear_paint
description: Remove every region painted with add_paint on one renderer or object.

nodeId.description: Uid of the renderer or object to clear.

nodeType.description: What nodeId refers to: a renderer, or an object (the colouring its renderers take by default).

name: set_default_color
description: Set the colour a painted renderer or object uses where no painted region applies (its base colour).

nodeId.description: Uid of the renderer or object to set it on.

nodeType.description: What nodeId refers to: a renderer, or an object (the colouring its renderers take by default).

name: save_object
description: Write one object to a file in the format its extension names (for a MolCoord object e.g. .pdb or .cif). Relative filenames are resolved from the current working directory. The output path is reported back.

name: set_coloring_prop
description: Set one property of the colouring a renderer or an object uses (what the CPK, Rainbow and B-factor sections of the Coloring panel change), e.g. col_C, start / end hue, mode, lowcol. A colouring still shared from a style is given its own copy first, so only this one changes.

nodeId.description: Uid of the renderer or object whose colouring to change.

nodeType.description: What nodeId refers to: a renderer, or an object (the colouring its renderers take by default).

prop.description: Property name of the colouring scheme.

value.description: The value, as text: a colour, a number, or a mode name.

name: add_paint
description: Colour part of what one renderer (or every renderer of an object that follows its colouring) draws, leaving the rest as it is. Use this for "make chain A red" or "colour the ligand yellow" -- set_renderer_coloring replaces the whole renderer's colouring instead. Painting the same renderer again adds another colour on top, so several regions can be coloured one call at a time.

nodeId.description: Uid of the renderer or object to paint.

nodeType.description: What nodeId refers to: a renderer, or an object (the colouring its renderers take by default).

selection.description: Which atoms to colour. Check it with count_selection first.

color.description: Colour as hex ("#FF0000"), a CueMol colour name ("red"), or hsb(h,s,b). Hex is the safest.

name: cut_surface
description: Cut a molecular surface object by the front clipping (slab) plane of the current view, as Tools > Mol surface cutter does. full keeps the surface and closes the cut with a cross section; separate puts the cross section in an object of its own; sect keeps only the cross section; body keeps the surface without one. Adjust the slab first (slab).

mode.description: What to keep. Null is full.

density.description: Cross-section mesh density per angstrom. Null uses 5.

name: list_morph_frames
description: List the frames of a morphing MolCoord object (made by add_morph_frame), in order.

name: add_morph_frame
description: Add a frame (another conformation of the same object) to a morphing animation, from a PDB file or from another MolCoord object in the scene. A plain MolCoord object is first turned into a morphing one, which gives it a new uid (returned). Play it with a Mol morphing element in the Animation panel.

objId.description: Uid of the MolCoord object to morph.

file.description: PDB file (.pdb, .ent, optionally .gz) to add. Null uses fromObjId.

fromObjId.description: Uid of a MolCoord object whose coordinates to add. Null uses file.

before.description: Insert before this frame, by its number in list_morph_frames (from 1). Null appends.

name: remove_morph_frame
description: Remove one frame from a morphing MolCoord object, by its number in list_morph_frames (from 1). The base frame, (this), cannot be removed.

objId.description: Uid of the morphing MolCoord object.

name: convert_to_morph
description: Turn a MolCoord object into a MorphMol (a morphing animation), its current coordinates the first frame. add_morph_frame does this by itself when it is needed.

name: export_image
description: Save a PNG of the current view to a file, only when the user asks for a file. To look at the view yourself, use capture_view, which saves nothing. Relative filenames are resolved from the current working directory. The output path is reported back.

width.description: Image width in pixels. Null uses the size of the view on screen.

height.description: Image height in pixels. Null uses the size of the view on screen.

name: list_anims
description: List the scene's animation: its length and settings, then each element with its type and times.

name: add_anim
description: Add an element to the animation: spin (rotate the view), camera (move to a camera), show / hide (a renderer), slidein / slideout, mol (morphing), wait (does nothing for a time). It follows the element before it; set what it acts on with set_anim_prop.

name.description: Its name. Null picks one.

before.description: Insert before this element. Null appends. The element: its number in list_anims (from 1), #uid, or its name.

name: remove_anim
description: Remove an element from the animation.

element.description: The element: its number in list_anims (from 1), #uid, or its name.

name: move_anim
description: Move an element to another place in the list (its number in list_anims, from 1).

element.description: The element: its number in list_anims (from 1), #uid, or its name.

by.description: Places to move from where it is now: negative is up, positive down. Stops at either end.

to.description: The number it should have, from 1.

end.description: Move it to the top or the bottom of the list.

name: set_anim_time
description: Set when an element runs, in milliseconds, relative to the end of the element it follows (or to the start of the animation when it follows none).

element.description: The element: its number in list_anims (from 1), #uid, or its name.

endMs.description: End, in milliseconds; after the start.

name: set_anim_prop
description: Set one property of an element, as the inspector does: name, timeRefName (the element it follows; empty for none), disabled, quadric (easing); spin: angle, axis ("0 1 0"); camera: endcam and ignorerotate / ignorecenter / ignorezoom / ignoreslab; show / hide / slide: rend (the renderer), hide, fade, tgtAlpha, direction, distance; mol: mol, startValue, endValue.

element.description: The element: its number in list_anims (from 1), #uid, or its name.

name: set_anim_generic_prop
description: Set any property of an element by its C++ name, as the inspector's generic tab does (set_anim_prop covers the usual ones by friendlier names).

element.description: The element: its number in list_anims (from 1), #uid, or its name.

prop.description: The property name, e.g. axis or tgt_alpha.

value.description: The new value, as text (a vector as "x y z").

name: reset_anim_prop
description: Reset properties of an element to their defaults.

element.description: The element: its number in list_anims (from 1), #uid, or its name.

props.description: The property names (C++ names, as the generic tab lists them), comma separated.

name: set_anim_options
description: Set whether the animation loops, and the camera it starts from (empty for none).

loop.description: Play it in a loop. Null leaves it.

startCamera.description: The camera it starts from; empty for none. Null leaves it.

name: calc_elepot
description: Calculate the electrostatic potential of a MolCoord object with APBS, as a new potential map object (to colour a surface by). Charges and radii come from pdb2pqr with a force field, or from CueMol itself (internal). Takes seconds to minutes. Returns the new object's uid.

selection.description: Only these atoms. Null uses the whole object.

name.description: Name for the map object. Null picks pot_<object>.

forceField.description: pdb2pqr force field. Null uses the one in Settings.

gridSpacing.description: Target grid spacing in angstroms. Null uses 1.

nonLinear.description: Solve the non-linear Poisson-Boltzmann equation. Null is false (linear).

useHydrogen.description: Keep the hydrogen atoms of the object. Null is false (they are added or ignored by the charge method).

waterDielec.description: Dielectric constant of the solvent. Null uses 78.54.

protDielec.description: Dielectric constant of the molecule. Null uses 2.

name: reset_prop
description: Put a property back to its default, named by its path as set_prop takes it (1crn/cartoon1.width, bgcolor). End the path in .* to reset every changed property of the node at once (Reset all in the inspector).

path.description: The property, or node.* for all of them.

name: clear_undo
description: Forget the scene's undo and redo history (Edit > Clear undo data). Cannot be undone.

name: export_scene
description: Export the view or the scene to a file (File > Export): png (with transparency and a DPI if asked), pov (POV-Ray scene), stl or mqo (3D models).

format.description: Null takes it from the file extension, else png.

width.description: Width in pixels. Null uses the view's size.

height.description: Height in pixels. Null uses the view's size.

transparent.description: png: a transparent background. Null is false.

dpi.description: png: the resolution written in the file. Null leaves it out.

name: load_pdb
description: Open a PDB file with the reader options of the File Open dialog. Each option left null keeps the reader's default. load_file opens one with all the defaults.

rendererType.description: Renderer to create for it. Null draws a molecule with the PyMOL-like preset DefaultPymRendPreset (cartoon, ligand sticks, ion spheres, water lines) when no selection is given, and anything else with its own default renderer.

selection.description: Draw only this selection. Null draws everything.

name.description: Name of the new object. Null uses the file name.

rendererName.description: Name of the renderer. Null uses <type>1.

preset.description: Draw it with this renderer preset (a group), instead of rendererType. Null leaves the choice to rendererType.

centerView.description: False leaves the view where it is. Null or true centres it on the new object.

mapCenterPolicy.description: For a map: setMapCenter draws it around the view centre, moveViewCenter moves the view to the map. Null or auto picks by the map kind.

loadModel.description: Read every model of a multi-model file (NMR), not only the first.

build2ndry.description: Compute the secondary structure instead of reading it from the file.

autoTopology.description: Build the bonds of residues the topology does not know.

name: load_mmcif
description: Open an mmCIF coordinate model with the reader options of the File Open dialog. Each option left null keeps the reader's default. Not for a structure-factor CIF: load_file or fetch_map reads that as a map.

rendererType.description: Renderer to create for it. Null draws a molecule with the PyMOL-like preset DefaultPymRendPreset (cartoon, ligand sticks, ion spheres, water lines) when no selection is given, and anything else with its own default renderer.

selection.description: Draw only this selection. Null draws everything.

name.description: Name of the new object. Null uses the file name.

rendererName.description: Name of the renderer. Null uses <type>1.

preset.description: Draw it with this renderer preset (a group), instead of rendererType. Null leaves the choice to rendererType.

centerView.description: False leaves the view where it is. Null or true centres it on the new object.

mapCenterPolicy.description: For a map: setMapCenter draws it around the view centre, moveViewCenter moves the view to the map. Null or auto picks by the map kind.

loadModel.description: Read every model of a multi-model file (NMR), not only the first.

build2ndry.description: Compute the secondary structure instead of reading it from the file.

autoTopology.description: Build the bonds of residues the topology does not know.

name: load_mtz
description: Open an MTZ file as a density map, choosing its columns and grid. Giving columnPhi or columnWeight also uses that column. Each option left null keeps the reader's default.

rendererType.description: Renderer to create for it. Null draws a molecule with the PyMOL-like preset DefaultPymRendPreset (cartoon, ligand sticks, ion spheres, water lines) when no selection is given, and anything else with its own default renderer.

selection.description: Draw only this selection. Null draws everything.

name.description: Name of the new object. Null uses the file name.

rendererName.description: Name of the renderer. Null uses <type>1.

preset.description: Draw it with this renderer preset (a group), instead of rendererType. Null leaves the choice to rendererType.

centerView.description: False leaves the view where it is. Null or true centres it on the new object.

mapCenterPolicy.description: For a map: setMapCenter draws it around the view centre, moveViewCenter moves the view to the map. Null or auto picks by the map kind.

columnF.description: The amplitude column, e.g. FWT or 2FOFCWT.

columnPhi.description: The phase column, e.g. PHWT. Giving it uses phases.

columnWeight.description: The weight column, e.g. FOM. Giving it uses weights.

name: load_ccp4
description: Open a CCP4 / MRC density map, with how its values are scaled and cut. Giving truncateMin or truncateMax also turns that truncation on. Each option left null keeps the reader's default.

rendererType.description: Renderer to create for it. Null draws a molecule with the PyMOL-like preset DefaultPymRendPreset (cartoon, ligand sticks, ion spheres, water lines) when no selection is given, and anything else with its own default renderer.

selection.description: Draw only this selection. Null draws everything.

name.description: Name of the new object. Null uses the file name.

rendererName.description: Name of the renderer. Null uses <type>1.

preset.description: Draw it with this renderer preset (a group), instead of rendererType. Null leaves the choice to rendererType.

centerView.description: False leaves the view where it is. Null or true centres it on the new object.

mapCenterPolicy.description: For a map: setMapCenter draws it around the view centre, moveViewCenter moves the view to the map. Null or auto picks by the map kind.

mapType.description: What kind of map: auto (from the header), xtal (crystallographic) or em.

subsample.description: Keep every n-th grid point on each axis.

name: load_msms
description: Open an MSMS surface: its .face file, and the .vert file beside it.

rendererType.description: Renderer to create for it. Null draws a molecule with the PyMOL-like preset DefaultPymRendPreset (cartoon, ligand sticks, ion spheres, water lines) when no selection is given, and anything else with its own default renderer.

selection.description: Draw only this selection. Null draws everything.

name.description: Name of the new object. Null uses the file name.

preset.description: Draw it with this renderer preset (a group), instead of rendererType. Null leaves the choice to rendererType.

mapCenterPolicy.description: For a map: setMapCenter draws it around the view centre, moveViewCenter moves the view to the map. Null or auto picks by the map kind.

vertFile.description: The .vert file. Null takes the one beside the .face file.

name: load_namd
description: Open NAMD coordinates (.coor) with the structure (.psf) that names their atoms.

rendererType.description: Renderer to create for it. Null draws a molecule with the PyMOL-like preset DefaultPymRendPreset (cartoon, ligand sticks, ion spheres, water lines) when no selection is given, and anything else with its own default renderer.

selection.description: Draw only this selection. Null draws everything.

name.description: Name of the new object. Null uses the file name.

rendererName.description: Name of the renderer. Null uses <type>1.

mapCenterPolicy.description: For a map: setMapCenter draws it around the view centre, moveViewCenter moves the view to the map. Null or auto picks by the map kind.

name: load_amber
description: Open an AMBER topology (prmtop), with a coordinate file (inpcrd / rst7) for its atoms.

rendererType.description: Renderer to create for it. Null draws a molecule with the PyMOL-like preset DefaultPymRendPreset (cartoon, ligand sticks, ion spheres, water lines) when no selection is given, and anything else with its own default renderer.

selection.description: Draw only this selection. Null draws everything.

name.description: Name of the new object. Null uses the file name.

rendererName.description: Name of the renderer. Null uses <type>1.

preset.description: Draw it with this renderer preset (a group), instead of rendererType. Null leaves the choice to rendererType.

centerView.description: False leaves the view where it is. Null or true centres it on the new object.

mapCenterPolicy.description: For a map: setMapCenter draws it around the view centre, moveViewCenter moves the view to the map. Null or auto picks by the map kind.

coordFile.description: The coordinate file. Null puts every atom at the origin.

name: fetch_map
description: Download the electron density map of a PDB entry (from its deposited structure factors) and add it to the scene with a contour. 2fofc is the usual map; fofc is the difference map, drawn at +/-3 sigma in two colours. Fetch the structure itself with fetch_pdb.

mapType.description: Which map: 2fofc (usual) or fofc (difference). Null is 2fofc.

name.description: Name for the map object. Null uses <pdbid>_<mapType>.

source.description: Where from: RCSB_CIF (validation report coefficients) or EBI_MTZ (PDBe MTZ). Null is RCSB_CIF.

name: superpose
description: Move one MolCoord object onto another by superposing selected atoms. USalign (the default) finds the structural alignment itself and handles proteins and nucleic acids (RNA/DNA); SSM matches by secondary structure (proteins only); LSQ fits the selected atoms in order, so the two selections must pair up atom for atom (e.g. the same residues' CA atoms). The moving object's coordinates change.

movId.description: Uid of the MolCoord object to move.

refId.description: Uid of the reference MolCoord object, which stays put.

movSel.description: Atoms of the moving object to fit. Null uses all (USalign, SSM) or CA atoms (LSQ).

refSel.description: Atoms of the reference to fit. Null as movSel.

pivot.description: USalign only: the atom that represents each residue. Null or auto uses CA for amino acids and C3' for nucleotides.

transform.description: False reports the fitted RMSD and transform without moving the molecule. Null or true applies the fit.

keepAsProperty.description: True keeps the fit as the object's transform (xformMat) and leaves the coordinates; null or false moves the coordinates.

name: define_selection
description: Give a selection expression a name, usable in any later selection (and listed by get_scene_state). The name stands for the expression, re-evaluated each time it is used.

name.description: The name, e.g. site1.

selection.description: The expression it stands for.

styleSet.description: Name of the style set to keep it in (the scene's own before a global one; made in the scene when there is none). Null uses the set named "default".

name: animate
description: Control the scene's animation (made in the Animation panel): play it, pause it, stop it, or show the frame at a time.

action.description: play, pause (keep the time), stop, or seek to timeMs.

timeMs.description: With seek: the time to show, in milliseconds. Null otherwise.

name: focus_node
description: Fit the view to one object or renderer (what double-clicking it in the scene tree does).

nodeId.description: Uid of the object, renderer, or renderer group.

name: list_node_props
description: List properties of a renderer, object, scene or view with current values, types, allowed values, read-only flags and default/reset state. Nested properties use dot paths. Read this before editing or resetting properties.

nodeType.description: What kind of node to address. "scene" is the scene as a whole; "view" is the current view; "renderer" also covers a renderer group.

nodeId.description: Uid of the object or renderer, from get_scene_state. Null for the scene and the view, which have no id of their own.

name: reset_node_props
description: Reset modified properties of one node to their registered or inherited defaults in one edit. Omit props to reset every modified property with a default. Names, selections, read-only properties and properties without defaults are preserved.

nodeType.description: What kind of node to address. "scene" is the scene as a whole; "view" is the current view; "renderer" also covers a renderer group.

nodeId.description: Uid of the object or renderer, from get_scene_state. Null for the scene and the view, which have no id of their own.

props.description: Property names from list_node_props. Omit to reset all modified properties with defaults.

name: set_node_prop
description:
Set one property of one node.

- On the scene: the background colour (`bgcolor`), ambient occlusion (`aoEnabled`, `aoRadius`, `aoIntensity`, `aoSteps`), anti-aliasing (`aa_method`, `aaJitterLevel`), and CMYK colour proofing (`use_colproof`, `icc_filename`).
- On the view: stereo (`stereoMode`, `stereoDist`, `swapStereoEyes`) and the centre mark (`centerMark`).
- On a renderer: a width, a detail level, or a mode.

Call `list_node_props` first: the property name, its type, and the allowed values all come from there.

nodeType.description: What kind of node to address. "scene" is the scene as a whole; "view" is the current view; "renderer" also covers a renderer group.

nodeId.description: Uid of the object or renderer, from get_scene_state. Null for the scene and the view, which have no id of their own.

prop.description: Property name, exactly as list_node_props reported it.

value.description: New value, written as text; it is converted to the property type. A colour is a name such as "white" or a hex code such as "#204080".

cascadeGroupVisibility.description: When setting a renderer group visibility, also update its members. Defaults to false for raw property edits.

name: set_prop
description: Set one property, named by its path: obj/rend.prop for a renderer, obj.prop for an object, view.prop for the view, and a bare name for the scene.

value.description: New value as text; converted by the property type.

name: get_prop
description: Read one property, named by its path as set_prop takes it.

name: set_render_settings
description: Set scene render parameters as key=value pairs separated by semicolons. Supported keys include width, height, unit, dpi, transparentBg, projection, clipPlane, edgeLines, and supported umbreon or umbreon_npr parameters. Unknown settings return an error.

name: move_node
description: Move an object to a place in the scene tree, or a renderer (or renderer group) to a place among the renderers of its object. Places count from 1, top first.

nodeId.description: Uid of the object, renderer, or renderer group.

nodeType.description: What nodeId refers to (a renderer group is a renderer here).

by.description: Places to move from where it is now: negative is up, positive down. Stops at either end.

to.description: The number it should have, from 1.

end.description: Move it to the top or the bottom of the list.

name: paste_node
description: Add an object, renderer, style set or camera from its CueMol XML (what Copy puts on the clipboard), renamed when its name is taken. A renderer goes onto the target object or group.

form.description: single: one node; rendArray: a renderer group with its renderers.

target.description: For a renderer: the object or renderer group to add it to.

name: create_style_set
description: Create an empty style set in the scene (scene tree > Styles > New).

name.description: Name of the new set; not one the scene has.

name: delete_style_set
description: Delete a style set.

styleSet.description: Name of the style set (the scene's own before a global one).

name: set_style_readonly
description: Make a scene's style set read only, or writable again. A changed set cannot be made read only.

styleSet.description: Name of the style set (the scene's own before a global one).

name: load_style_file
description: Load a style file into the scene as a read-only style set.

name: save_style_file
description: Save a style set to a file. Null path writes it back to the file it came from.

styleSet.description: Name of the style set (the scene's own before a global one).

path.description: Where to write it (.xml). Null uses its source file.

name: define_color
description: Give a colour a name in a style set (the Style Editor's Colors tab), usable wherever a colour is.

name.description: The colour's name.

color.description: The colour: hex ("#FF0000"), a colour name, or hsb(h,s,b).

styleSet.description: The style set to keep it in (the scene's own before a global one; made in the scene when there is none). Null uses the set named "default".

name: remove_color
description: Remove a colour from a style set (the Style Editor).

styleSet.description: Name of the style set (the scene's own before a global one).

name.description: The colour's name.

name: remove_selection
description: Remove a named selection from a style set (the Style Editor).

styleSet.description: Name of the style set (the scene's own before a global one).

name.description: The named selection's name.

name: remove_style
description: Remove a style from a style set (the Style Editor).

styleSet.description: Name of the style set (the scene's own before a global one).

name.description: The style's name.
